title: StatusAnnouncement
description: Response format for the status command. Navigation position and completion progress MUST be announced separately. Ambiguous output such as 'Schritt x von y' without explicit reference level is forbidden.

navigation.description: Current navigation position in the form structure. Identifies where the user is, not how much is completed.

progress.description: Completion progress across one or more calculation bases. Each dimension reports completed vs. total counts for relevant items only.

openRequiredFieldCount.description: Number of relevant required fields that are not yet completed.

validationErrorCount.description: Number of active validation errors with severity=error across all relevant fields.

Id.description: Identifier: starts with letter/underscore, followed by alphanumerics, dots, dashes, or underscores.

NavigationPosition.description: Current navigation position. Identifies the active field group and field, and optionally the active form in multi-form applications.

currentFormId.description: Active form identifier. Present only in multi-form applications.

currentFormIndex.description: 1-based position of the active form. Present only in multi-form applications.

totalForms.description: Total number of forms in the application. Present only in multi-form applications.

currentFieldGroupIndex.description: 1-based position of the active field group within the relevant form scope (conditionally hidden groups are excluded from the basis).

totalFieldGroups.description: Total number of field groups in the relevant form scope (conditionally hidden groups are excluded from the basis).

currentFieldId.description: Active field identifier within the current field group. Absent when the user is at field-group level (e.g. during FIELD_GROUP_INTRO or FIELD_GROUP_SUMMARY).

CompletionProgress.description: Completion progress. At least one dimension MUST be present. Each dimension reports completed vs. total counts for relevant items only (non-relevant items are excluded from both numerator and denominator).

allFields.description: Progress over all relevant fields regardless of mandatory/optional status.

requiredFieldsOnly.description: Progress over relevant required fields only.

fieldGroupBased.description: Progress over relevant field groups. A field group counts as completed when all its relevant required fields are completed without severity=error violations.

ProgressDimension.description: A single progress dimension with completed and total counts.

completed.description: Number of relevant items that are completed (set + no active severity=error violation).

total.description: Total number of relevant items (excludes non-relevant items from denominator).

ProgressCalculationBasis.description: Selects which progress dimension is primary for announcements.
